references.name: fanta-front
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary full Fanta front photograph. Pale warm cream masonry and stone bands,red-brick stepped/curved central gable,a very large recessed round-arched glazed entrance with muted green frames and shallow glass/green-metal canopy. Two tall rounded central clock turrets have stacked windows,broad circular cornices,lantern-like glass caps and slim poles. Long two-storey lateral ranges have repeated ground round arches and upper curved-top windows under terracotta pitched roofs. Figurative sculpture,coats of arms,lettering,brands,people andvehicles are excluded rather than copied.

references.name: whole-station-aerial
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary whole-station aerial photograph. Complete historic long frontage includes both large square outer pavilions with steep red tiled roofs and dark clock/spire tops,not only the central round turrets. Behind it are two full long curved metal/glass train sheds with open platform space and extended low roof rows. The separate low modern terminal west of the road has dark glazed park facade and a broad roof parking/terrace deck with parapets,ramp-like rounded ends,vent/entry shafts and lighting. Preserve the road separating modern andhistoric buildings,open rail spaces,park andindependent neighboring buildings. This is an ordinary picture,not a surveyed elevation or current construction-stage record.

note: Two adequate ordinary photographs inspected. Retained exact OSM relation4257415/Q751174 belongs to the modern7m terminal,not the historic Fanta building or every shed.
